<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LegoMachine"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LegoMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Builder" name="Builder">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Build</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DevelopDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PartsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReorderParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TestResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RedesignSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MachineBuilt</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Group of children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Build" name="Machine build started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsMerge" name="Parts needed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsAvailable" name="Parts left in container?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Test successful?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign and rebuild subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" name="Assemble subcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineBuilt" name="Machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Build" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${partsAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!partsAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${testSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!testSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_PartsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponent" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineBuilt"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
